samples.xml_description:
<module id="clkgenerator">
    <description>A clock generator module that produces a periodic clock signal, toggling its output state at regular intervals defined by the PERIOD parameter.</description>
    <ports>
        <output id="clk">The output clock signal generated by the module.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="PERIOD">The period of the clock signal, which determines the frequency of the clock.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>Initializes the clock signal to 0 and toggles it every half of the specified PERIOD.</implementation>
</module>
